title: First visit to Alhambra.
text: Excellent experience and excellent explanation from our guide, he made the tour go by very quickly.
author: oscardP483MU

title: Great guided tour
text: Our tour guide was very knowledgeable and friendly.  Took us through expertly.  Wonderful experience in a very beautiful place.
author: Joann_V

title: Alhambra
text: The Alhambra was amazing. I would not go in July or August as even June there were plenty of crowds to deal with. We stayed the the Alhambra Palace Hotel just outside of the Alhambra and can't recommend this highly enough.10/10
author: elizabethp496

title: Great way of seeing the Alhambra and understanding its history
text:
Great tour. Aitana was an excellent guide. 
Group was not too big so manageable. 
We were given headsets so could clearly hear the guide and it was a well organised tour. 

Tickets also gave us re entry so we went back after to spend more time in the Generalife gardens as these were a little rushed.
author: Sonali_S

title: Very informative
text:
Our guide was very well informed on the history of the Alhambra and did a great job sharing his insights.
We found the information very interesting.
author: 74tonyz

title: Insightful, Relaxed, Beautiful: Alhambra at Its Best
text:
From start to finish, our experience was truly lovely. Georgia, our guide, struck the perfect balance of knowledgeable and approachable. Her British accent made her especially easy to understand, and her warm, personable style made the tour feel relaxed and engaging.

At the beginning, there were a few unexpected distractions with other guests, but Georgia handled everything with professionalism and grace, never letting it impact the overall experience. It was clear she genuinely cared about creating a great tour for everyone.

author: Angela_B

title: La Alhambra
text: This is a 3 hour + tour as there is so much to see at La Alhambra, but this is must-see site if visiting Granada. The tour was very informative and Antonio our tour guide was excellent. He kept the tour group engaged with fun facts and questions along the way. He was also very kind in checking in with the people on the tour group, taking pictures and calling taxis afterwards for people who did not want to walk back to the city. He also provided several restaurant recommendations in Granada.
author: Marie_K

title: A must see with scholar Antonio.
text: Antonio was our guide- he is a scholar in all things related to Alhambra and the area.  We had a small group of ten and he knew a few little known spots to venture into.  I left the tour knowing so much more about the moorish culture and the culture of the royals who lived there.  Antonio answered all questions and adjusted pace where needed.  We visited all three areas with no waiting. We have been on many Viator tours but this tour and in particular, Antonio, excelled others.
author: Jane_H

title: Expensive, but worth it.
text:
We booked at short notice, so probably could.have found a cheaper option if that weren't the case, but we felt this was well worth the money we spent.
Our guide was informative, knowledgeable and humorous as well.

Even though a small group, the ear pieces made the tour far better than it otherwise might have been as you didn't have to stand right next to the guide to hear what they were telling the group. This was particularly useful in the more crowded areas.
author: theb912

title: Absorbing experience
text: Very good especially considering the experience of the guide Elias.  He was very attentive, explained patiently and answered all the questions.
